tone-1ch.ogg and tone-2ch.ogg are original synthetic 440 Hz sine waves,
0.1 seconds, 48000 Hz, mono and stereo respectively. These test fixtures
are dedicated to the public domain under CC0 1.0 Universal:
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

Generated with ffmpeg's sine source (PCM s16le WAV), then converted using
Mods/ForgeCore/Audio/tools/convert_audio.py convert at its default quality 6.
ffmpeg/ffprobe version: 9.0.2-full_build-www.gyan.dev.

Reproduce the WAV for each channel count (1 or 2), then run the converter:
ffmpeg -f lavfi -i sine=frequency=440:sample_rate=48000:duration=0.1 -ac 1 tone.wav
python Mods/ForgeCore/Audio/tools/convert_audio.py convert tone.wav tone-1ch.ogg

tone-long-1ch.ogg: 2 second 440 Hz mono sine (CC0 1.0), ffmpeg 9.0.2, used only for final-granule edit tests:
ffmpeg -f lavfi -i sine=frequency=440:duration=2:sample_rate=48000 -ac 1 -c:a libvorbis -q:a 1 tone-long-1ch.ogg
